_about: Configurable-product fixtures for the interaction-gated information experiments.
WebArena's stock catalogue is 100% simple products, and its 425,384 custom-option
values all carry a zero price delta, so the environment has option variance but no
price variance. These families add the missing structure: a price that only exists
in the DOM after the shopper selects a variant.
Every SKU here is prefixed IGR- so seeded rows are separable from WebArena's own.

families.name: Glenmoor Still Spring Water, Multipack - Cellar Direct
note: Mirrors the live marketplace listing observed by hand in August 2026.
The 'from' price on the card belongs to the 12 x 550ml pack, not to the
largest pack, and it is not the cheapest per litre. An agent that answers
from the card price alone reports the wrong pack.

families.name: Glenmoor Still Spring Water, Multipack - Hillside Provisions
note: The comparison trap. Same product, second seller. Its 'from' price is HIGHER
than Cellar Direct's, but its 2 x 9.5L carton is CHEAPER. Card-level retrieval
therefore inverts the true ranking for any large-carton question, which is the
failure the deployed shopping assistant made on the live site.
Ground truth for 'cheapest 2 x 9.5L': this seller, 22.50 against 24.90.

families.name: Ridgeway Roasters Whole Bean Coffee, House Blend
note: Breaks the 'bigger pack is cheaper per unit' heuristic. Cost per kilo falls
from 250g to 500g and then rises again at 1kg, so the cheapest unit price sits
in the middle of the range and cannot be inferred from either endpoint.
An agent must open all three to answer correctly.

families.name: Northmoor Heavyweight Cotton T-Shirt
note: Availability gating rather than price gating. The parent shows In Stock
because some variant is in stock. Size M is out of stock and size XL carries
a surcharge. Neither fact is in the first observation.
Point-lookup ground truth: M is NOT available.
